Login page crashes when token is missing

Product: Auth Service
Component: authentication
Severity: major
Environment: macOS 14, app 1.2.0

When I try to login without a token, the app crashes instead of showing a validation error.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the login page
2. Submit login without token

Expected: System should show a validation error.
Actual: Application crashes.

Log: TypeError: token is None at src/auth/validator.py:42

ticket.title: Checkout page becomes blank after applying a discount code
ticket.description: After entering a discount code on the checkout page, the page becomes blank. Refreshing the browser restores the cart, but the discount is not applied.
ticket.logs: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total') at src/checkout/discounts.ts:88
steps_to_reproduce: Open a cart with one item
ticket.expected_behavior: The discount should be applied and the order total should update.

scenarios.user_input:
Ticket ID: RAW-202
Checkout page becomes blank after applying a discount code

Reporter: qa-checkout@example.com
Product: Checkout UI
Component: frontend
Severity: major
Environment: Chrome 124, macOS 14, app 2.4.1

After entering a discount code on the checkout page, the page becomes blank. Refreshing the browser restores the cart, but the discount is not applied.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open a cart with one item
2. Go to checkout
3. Enter discount code SPRING20
4. Click Apply

Expected: The discount should be applied and the order total should update.
Actual: The checkout page becomes blank.

Log: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total') at src/checkout/discounts.ts:88
